question: In which Indian city is the prestigious Subroto Cup inter-school football tournament conducted every year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Subroto Cup is an annual inter-school football tournament held in **New Delhi, India**, named after Air Marshal Subroto Mukerjee, the founding father of the Indian Air Force.
 
• It was first organized in **1960** and has since become one of the most prestigious football tournaments for school-level teams in India.
 
• The competition is organized by the **Indian Air Force** in collaboration with the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports and the Subroto Mukerjee Sports Education Society.
 
• It features participation from schools across **India and abroad**, making it an international event.
 
• The tournament is held in various age categories, primarily under-14 and under-17 for boys and under-17 for girls.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hyderabad**

 
 
• Hyderabad is known for its historical landmarks like the Charminar and Golconda Fort, and it serves as the capital of Telangana.
 
• The city is also a major hub for IT industries and is home to the famous **Hyderabad FC**, a football team playing in the Indian Super League (ISL).
 
 
 
• **Mumbai**
 
 
• Mumbai, the financial capital of India, is renowned for cricket and its iconic Wankhede Stadium.
 
• The city also promotes football through clubs like Mumbai City FC, which competes in the ISL.
 
• Mumbai has hosted several international and national-level sports events.
 
 
 
• **Lucknow**
 
 
• Lucknow, the capital city of Uttar Pradesh, is famous for its cultural heritage, including Nawabi cuisine and classical dance forms like Kathak.
 
• The city has hosted events in cricket and hocky.
